d:
I visualized the Mahabharata on a map!
Have you ever wondered why Tamil Nadu, Kerala, and Karnataka supported the Pandavas while Bengal, Odisha, and the Telugu states went full Kaurava?
Why was Kashmir playing neutral like Switzerland during World War 2?
I spent the last six months mapping every single kingdom mentioned in the Mahabharata, and what I discovered will completely change how you see this epic.
What You'll Discover:
The real reason South Indian kingdoms traveled 1000+ km to fight in a North Indian family dispute
